docSummary: Synthetic fixture for an invented client 'Agency X': one AMS tower combining 12 eServices (Portal, Callup, Manning, Deferment, Payslip, Registration, Clearance, Pay, Awards, Leave and Claims, Retail, Posting; 'Booklet' already decommissioned) plus two separate manual-automation opportunities (account review, log analysis). The FY25 table (April 2025-31 March 2026, a stated 12-month period) totals 3066 SRs, 636 incidents (Sev A 155 / Sev B 474 / Sev C 7, mapped to P1/P2/P3 with P4=0) and 202 CRs; dividing by 12 gives ≈255.5 SR/month, ≈53.0 incidents/month (P1 24.37%, P2 74.53%, P3 1.10%, P4 0%) and ≈16.83 CR/month. 92 job/batch failures (Pay 30, Awards 8, Retail 54) are operational counters, not incidents, and were excluded. L1 is explicitly out of the vendor's scope (agency help desk / client-run L1.5 team), so pass12 was omitted; pass23 ≈5% (L2→L3 escalation) was used. Treated as brownfield (incumbent services team sized 30-36, midpoint 33) against a legacy, mid-migration (Java 11→17) estate whose hosting (Singapore public cloud) is run by a separate vendor and is not sized as a tower.

warnings: Session 3 flags that an earlier session reported platform-wide Sev A = 6 for FY25, but the FY25 table in session 4 sums to Sev A = 155 (Callup 140 + Manning 15); used the table (most recent, explicit) value.

Suspect figures in the FY25 table: Callup Sev A = 140 against only 80 SRs (far higher than any other service's severity count); Leave and Claims shows 1600 SRs but only 10 CRs; Retail shows 890 SRs, 1 CR and 54 job failures - verify against the source system.
'Job Failures' column (total 92: Pay 30, Awards 8, Retail 54, Posting 0) are operational counters, not logged incidents, and were excluded from inc/mix.
L1 is explicitly out of the vendor's scope (agency help desk); the client-run L1.5 team's 20-30% ticket-handling rate is an intermediate-team figure, not used for pass12 (pass12 omitted).
Hosting (public cloud, Singapore region) is run by a separate hosting vendor and security incidents by a separate enterprise team - neither is sized as a tower for the bidder.
Platform team (18 people) is a separate tender and was excluded from incumbentFTE and towers.
incumbentFTE (33) is the midpoint of the stated 30-36 person range for the incumbent services team.
Conflicting user counts: 'fewer than 1000 users are supported' vs '4000 concurrent users at maximum' - could not reconcile; mau field omitted.
Account-review automation scope changed between sessions: 10 systems (session 1) updated to 12 sources across 5 categories (session 3) - latest figure used in opportunities.
Session 4 asks to obtain six-month manning data to set a full 12-month baseline, implying Manning's row may be partial-year despite the FY25 full-year table header - verify completeness.
AIOps pipeline integration is only a stated future intent with commercial green light still pending as of session 1 - aiops=true reflects intent, not confirmed scope.
eng.term was not stated anywhere in the document and is omitted.
eng.region/locMix omitted - only the hosting location (Singapore, run by a separate vendor) is stated; no bidder delivery-location was given.
CR complexity mix (crMix) was described only qualitatively ('mostly policy driven', 'time consuming') with no low/medium/high split, so it was omitted.
L1.5 (3-4 people, 24x7) and incumbent/platform team sizes are context; L2/L3 ownership by the bidder is inferred from the incumbent-team takeover framing, not an explicit ownership statement.
